settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Iwo Jima February 1945, U.S. Marine composite soldier POV, black volcanic sand, landing craft, smoke, steep terrain, cave and pillbox positions at distance, authentic Pacific uniforms and gear, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD. Prioritize volcanic texture, heat, ash, sweat, breath, unstable footing, smoke layers and exhausted pauses rather than constant combat.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite U.S. Marine POV during the Iwo Jima landings and early advance. One main action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration and no intelligible human speech. Do not make every scene active combat. Use realistic quiet beats in craters, night positions, resupply and observation. Battlefield audio must rise and fall naturally; some scenes should contain only breath, ash, wind, surf, equipment and very distant fighting.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person Pacific island warfare reenactment, black volcanic sand, humid haze, smoke layers, sweat-darkened fabric, ash on gloves and gear, restrained handheld camera, non-graphic. Camera movement feels physically heavy and fatigued, with slips, pauses and natural head sway. Preserve ash, sweat, dust and gear continuity.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP05 — Iwo Jima: Black Sand Landing
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. Marine experiences the opening days of the Iwo Jima battle, from the landing craft and black volcanic beach to the inland push and a later glimpse of the flag on Mount Suribachi, ending with the reminder that the battle is still far from over.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite U.S. Marine during the Iwo Jima landings beginning 19 February 1945. Make the viewer feel loose volcanic ash giving way under boots, humid air, sweat under gear, salt spray, soot, smoke, thirst, tired arms and the relief of brief cover. Do not use gunfire or explosions in every scene. Include quiet crater, night, resupply and observation scenes where environmental sound and breathing dominate. Tell everything visually with no spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Approaching the Island
scenes.description: POV inside a landing craft as Iwo Jima emerges through humid haze.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks over the landing craft side toward the island while one hand steadies against vibrating wet metal.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. Marine POV from landing craft toward hazy volcanic Iwo Jima, Mount Suribachi visible in distance, gray sea, salt droplets on metal, damp sleeves and period gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan from inside craft toward island. Audio foreground: breathing, wet glove on vibrating metal, sling hardware. Mid-ground: engine and waves. Background: distant naval gunfire softened by sea wind. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Ramp to Black Sand
scenes.description: The craft reaches shore and the ramp drops.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV steps off the ramp onto black volcanic sand and immediately sinks at the ankles under the weight of gear.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over landing craft ramp onto Iwo Jima black sand beach, Marines moving inland through smoke, wet boots entering loose dark ash, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Ramp drops once and camera moves forward onto sand with one unstable step. Audio: ramp crash, surf, ash under boots, equipment bounce, heavy breathing and distant artillery. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Sand Gives Way
scenes.description: The soldier struggles to climb the loose volcanic terrace.
scenes.actionDescription: Boots sink into loose black ash while the POV pushes uphill, sliding back slightly after each step.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person downward view of boots sinking into coarse black volcanic sand, individual ash grains on wet boots, rifle and gloved hands visible, Marines climbing ahead through haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low first-person struggle uphill with unstable footing. Audio foreground: heavy breathing, ash sliding, webbing creak. Background: distant combat rather than continuous nearby fire. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Beach Cover
scenes.description: The POV drops behind a low sand ridge as smoke crosses the beach.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier crouches behind one volcanic ridge, presses a glove into warm loose ash and looks inland.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low cover behind black sand ridge, gloved hand partly buried in coarse ash, smoke drifting in layers, Marines moving inland, landing craft behind, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops low, pauses for one breath, then tilts once inland. Audio: surf, ash shifting, distant shelling, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Push Inland
scenes.description: The squad leaves the beach and moves toward the first inland positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows two Marines along a marked route inland, stepping around churned ash and scattered equipment.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person movement across dark volcanic ground with sparse vegetation, Marines ahead, smoke and beach behind, ash sticking to damp boots and trousers.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward tracking along one route. Audio: boots on ash, wind, gear movement, breathing and occasional distant fire. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Airfield Edge
scenes.description: The soldier reaches rough ground near Airfield No. 1 and watches rather than fires.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV pauses behind a shallow berm and scans the airfield edge without taking a shot.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle resting over rough berm looking toward wartime airfield ground, churned volcanic soil, smoke haze, no visible close enemy, ash on rifle stock.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow horizontal scan across airfield edge. POV does not fire. Audio: wind, loose gravel, breathing and sparse distant bursts with long gaps. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Across the Open Ground
scenes.description: The squad makes a short move across exposed terrain.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV runs once from berm to a crater edge, stumbling slightly as boots dig into soft ash.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint across dark volcanic airfield terrain toward shallow crater, squadmates ahead, ash kicking up around boots, smoke in distance.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single fast forward run ending at crater cover. Audio: boots, ash spray, equipment bounce, heavy breathing and distant gunfire. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Crater Position
scenes.description: A deliberate quiet recovery scene inside a shallow crater.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers the rifle, rests one forearm on the crater edge and stays still while breathing slows slightly.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person inside shallow volcanic crater, black ash pressed into glove seams, scratched rifle resting low, Marine helmets barely visible nearby, smoky terrain ahead and no active firing in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly static low POV. No gunfire nearby, no explosion and no music. Audio foreground: heavy breathing gradually easing, ash grains sliding under elbow, fabric and sling creak. Mid-ground: wind over crater lip. Background: battle very distant and intermittent. Let silence breathe. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Night Flares
scenes.description: A quiet night-watch scene as illumination flares drift over the island.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks upward as one flare descends slowly, casting moving shadows over the crater walls.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person night view from volcanic fighting position, one bright illumination flare overhead, pale moving shadows on black ash, smoke and dark ridges, Marines low in cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt to one descending flare, then hold. No nearby firing, no explosion, no music. Audio: flare hiss, night wind, breathing, occasional ash movement and one very distant artillery rumble. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Morning Ash
scenes.description: The next morning the squad advances through smoke and ash at an exhausted pace.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad through one low smoky corridor, shoulders moving heavily under gear.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person morning movement through volcanic ridges, smoke haze, Marines in period gear ahead, ash-coated sleeves and boots, no graphic imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward handheld movement through one terrain corridor. Audio: boots on ash, wind, gear movement, tired breathing; background combat sparse. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Water and Ammunition
scenes.description: A quiet resupply and hydration scene emphasizing physical exhaustion.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV accepts a canteen and ammunition bundle, takes one brief drink and rests the canteen against a knee.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hands receiving scratched canteen and ammunition bundle behind volcanic ridge, sweat-darkened sleeves, ash dust on gear, helmets nearby and background softly hazed by smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: One handoff followed by a short drink. No firing nearby, no explosion and no music. Audio: gear clink, canteen cap, water movement, swallowing, breathing and light wind. Leave a short quiet pause after drinking. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Suribachi in the Distance
scenes.description: The POV sees Mount Suribachi through thinning smoke and quietly watches for several seconds.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward Mount Suribachi and remains still, one ash-covered glove resting on the ridge.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person distant view of Mount Suribachi across dark volcanic terrain, smoke thinning in layers, period Marines in foreground, ash-covered glove and rifle low in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan toward Suribachi, then hold. Audio: wind, distant guns reduced to faint background, fabric and breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Flag on the Mountain
scenes.description: Days later, a flag can be seen on Mount Suribachi from afar.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV raises binoculars toward a small distant U.S. flag on Suribachi and holds the view without celebration.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view of Mount Suribachi with a small distant U.S. flag visible at summit, atmospheric haze, no recreation of famous close-up flag-raising pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and hold on distant summit. Audio: wind, distant combat, binocular handling and breathing. No cheering, no speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Northward
scenes.description: The squad turns away from Suribachi toward the remaining island battle.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV lowers binoculars and faces rough northern terrain, shifting weight before starting forward.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view north across rugged Iwo Jima terrain with smoke and ridges ahead, flag no longer in frame, ash-coated glove, dusty rifle and uneven ground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn away from Suribachi toward northern terrain. Audio: wind, boots shifting on ash, equipment and breathing, distant battle returning gradually. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Not Over
scenes.description: The episode ends with the squad advancing as fighting continues elsewhere.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad forward over dark volcanic ground at a tired steady pace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person following U.S. Marines north across Iwo Jima volcanic terrain, smoke ahead, late-day light, ash on boots and gear, no victory celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward movement with squad. Audio: boots on ash, wind, equipment movement, distant battle and tired breathing. End with ongoing battlefield atmosphere, not triumph. No speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous first-person Marine used as the viewer perspective; historically plausible 1945 Pacific uniform and equipment; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: USMC field uniform, M1 helmet with cover, web gear, gloves, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep sleeves, gloves, rifle, helmet shadow, volcanic dust and gear consistent. Ash, sweat, soot and fatigue accumulate naturally across scenes and must not reset. Avoid clear facial depiction.

atmosphereAssets.title: Offshore Approach
atmosphereAssets.description: Gray Pacific water, landing craft vibration, salt spray, humid haze and the outline of Iwo Jima and Mount Suribachi; distant naval sound carried across open water.

atmosphereAssets.title: Iwo Jima Beach and Southern Interior
atmosphereAssets.description: Loose black volcanic sand, steep terraces, layered smoke, humid air, ash on clothing, low ridges and early inland positions; sound alternates between surf, wind, breathing and distant battlefield activity.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: gray daylight to night flare illumination

atmosphereAssets.title: Airfield and Northern Advance Route
atmosphereAssets.description: Open volcanic terrain, shallow craters, rough berms, ash-coated ground, heat haze and ridges leading north; exposed areas contrast with quiet crater cover.
